mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments(user_id, etf_id, content) VALUES(#{userId}, #{etfId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id u.nickname, -- 닉네임 c.content, -- 내용 c.sentiment, -- 감정 c.created_at, -- 최초 작성 시간 c.updated_at -- 수정 시간 FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.etf_id = #{etfId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
